citation: Broussard JL, et al. 2015. Elevated ghrelin predicts food intake during experimental sleep restriction. Obesity 24:132.
protocol: 4 nights of 8.5 h in bed (23:00-07:30) vs 4 nights of 4.5 h in bed (01:00-05:30), crossover; blood sampled for 24 h during standardized meals
population: n=19 healthy young lean men, age 23.5 +/- 0.7 y, BMI 23.1 +/- 0.4 kg/m2

reports.where: Table 1, 24-h mean, nocturnal mean and meal peaks/nadirs (normal sleep vs restriction)

note: Table 1 gives mean +/- SEM for 24-h hormone profiles; pancreatic polypeptide is also in the table but is not one of the wanted markers. Licence is the publisher's author-reuse terms, not CC.
